The approved item is: “Those tests pass on any date: each one finds the lines it checks by their text, or runs with a fixed clock, and the full suite passes on the default branch”. The assertions remove the factory-numbers line by its text, but still select the advice they check by position, and their clocks are not fixed. The same coupling remains at test_readloop_gates.py:270, :308 and :317, test_builders_edits_need_no_new_read.py:52, and test_merge_command.py:254. A change to the unrelated numbers-line wording or another report footer can therefore break these tests while the checked advice remains correct.
